comment: The section describes the conformance model as a “small, self-contained extension” to the ArchiMate core. It is unclear whether this extension remains fully conformant to ArchiMate or introduces project-specific modelling conventions.

anchor.note: p.79 l.Lines 991-997 read as the printed page; section 3.7.2 agrees

public.text: The section describes the conformance model as a “small, self-contained extension” to the ArchiMate core. It is unclear whether this extension remains fully conformant to ArchiMate or introduces project-specific modelling conventions.
public.suggestedRevision: State explicitly which elements and relationships are native ArchiMate constructs and which are DPI-H modelling conventions. Publish the conventions as a formal profile with examples and validation rules.
